subject: Load JSON module into the test framework (#198)
reason: The change is confined to valkey-search's own test/CI infrastructure: integration/run.sh gains a venv setup and a step that clones and builds the valkey-json module, the pytest fixture loads that JSON module next to the search module, and scripts/common.rc gets a log helper. No source file of the module itself changes, so the built valkey-search artifact at the change is behaviourally identical to the parent's: no command reply, indexing path, replication or persistence behaviour differs, and there is nothing a fuzzer scenario against real servers could reach.
